boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Taylor University environments for independent work, collaborative sessions, research, and writing support.

cards.title: Zondervan Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Zondervan Library, Taylor University
cards.notes: Choose a room for a project meeting or shared problem set; Taylor documents study rooms of various sizes throughout the library.
cards.short_summary: Library rooms set aside for group work of different sizes.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor’s academic catalog states that groups may use study rooms of various sizes throughout Zondervan Library.
cards.source_title: Taylor University Academic Catalog — Campus Facilities
cards.access_notes: Taylor identifies these as group-use rooms in Zondervan Library; confirm availability or any reservation process with the library.

cards.title: Zondervan Library Quiet Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Main level, Zondervan Library
cards.notes: Use a pod when you need a contained seat for focused computer work, a remote meeting, or an interview-style call.
cards.short_summary: Two enclosed individual pods with noise-reducing walls and power.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor reports two individual study pods on the library’s main level with noise-canceling walls, electrical outlets, and adjustable-footrest stools.
cards.access_notes: The pods are on Zondervan Library’s main level; Taylor describes them for individual use, including Zoom meetings and interviews.

cards.entity_name: Zondervan Library Main-Level Study Tables and Carrels
cards.title: Zondervan’s Main-Level Study Tables and Carrels
cards.subtitle: Main level, Zondervan Library
cards.notes: Set up with your course reading or research materials at a table or carrel on the main level of the library.
cards.short_summary: A library-level choice between shared tables and individual carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor’s academic catalog identifies study tables and carrels on Zondervan Library’s main and upper levels as study areas.
cards.source_title: Taylor University Academic Catalog — Campus Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s main level; use is subject to the library’s normal building access and any posted rules.

cards.entity_name: Zondervan Library Upper-Level Study Tables and Carrels
cards.title: Zondervan’s Upper-Level Study Tables and Carrels
cards.subtitle: Upper level, Zondervan Library
cards.notes: Bring independent reading, outlining, or research tasks to an upper-level table or carrel and choose the seating format you need.
cards.short_summary: Upper-level library seating for individual work or a shared table session.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor’s academic catalog identifies study tables and carrels on Zondervan Library’s main and upper levels as study areas.
cards.source_title: Taylor University Academic Catalog — Campus Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s upper level; use is subject to the library’s normal building access and any posted rules.

cards.title: Ringenberg Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Archives & Special Collections, Zondervan Library
cards.notes: Plan a research session around archival materials, and contact the University Archivist in advance to arrange reading-room access.
cards.short_summary: A supervised research setting for working directly with archival collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that archival materials must be viewed in the Ringenberg Reading Room and asks visiting researchers to schedule an appointment.
cards.access_notes: Advance contact is requested for use of the reading room; archival materials are non-circulating and may have access restrictions.

cards.title: Archives & Special Collections
cards.subtitle: Southeast end of Zondervan Library’s Engstrom Galleria
cards.notes: Use this destination when primary sources fit your assignment; ask staff about open collections, restrictions, and how to request materials.
cards.short_summary: Taylor’s archival research destination, including University history and special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor’s catalog says Archives & Special Collections preserves records of enduring value and is located at the southeast end of Zondervan Library’s Engstrom Galleria.
cards.source_title: Taylor University Academic Catalog — Campus Facilities
cards.access_notes: Collections are available to the Taylor community, visiting scholars, and the public with some restrictions; contact the archivist for access.

cards.title: Academic Enrichment Center
cards.subtitle: Northwest wing, Zondervan Library
cards.notes: Visit for structured academic support, study counseling, tutoring, or help connecting with the Writing Center and accessibility services.
cards.short_summary: A library-based academic-support environment with tutoring and study guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that the Academic Enrichment Center is in Zondervan Library’s northwest wing and provides study counseling, tutoring, and Writing Center services.
cards.source_title: Taylor University Academic Catalog — Academic Enrichment Center
cards.access_notes: The AEC serves Taylor students; appointments can be arranged through the AEC team, and service-specific requirements may apply.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Zondervan Library
cards.notes: Book a one-on-one writing conversation when you need to develop ideas, organize a draft, strengthen a thesis, or work through citations.
cards.short_summary: Peer-led writing support for drafting, revision, and English-language questions.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor says the Writing Center in Zondervan Library provides peer tutoring through one-on-one writing discussions and lists appointment hours.
cards.access_notes: Appointments are made through Taylor’s Writing Center scheduling site. The official page lists afternoon and evening tutoring hours.

cards.title: Euler Science Complex Atrium
cards.subtitle: Between Euler Science Complex and Nussbaum Center
cards.notes: Use the large atrium’s flexible seating for solo review or a project check-in, then keep the space ready for its events and performances.
cards.short_summary: A large, flexible collaborative environment linking two science buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor describes the atrium connecting Euler and Nussbaum as a large gathering area for study, with seating that supports varied arrangements.
cards.access_notes: This is a multi-use gathering area that also hosts performances and events; check campus scheduling or posted conditions before extended use.

cards.title: LaRita Boren Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Taylor University campus center
cards.notes: Choose the campus center when you want to read or work near dining and student-services destinations, while respecting active programming nearby.
cards.short_summary: A central campus hub Taylor explicitly identifies as a study destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor describes the LaRita Boren Campus Center as a central campus hub and a place to study, eat, or connect with student development programs.
cards.access_notes: The center also houses dining facilities and student-development offices; study access can be affected by programming and building operations.
